objective: Preserve a truthful, resumable BigBounce checkpoint across machines.

tasks.title: Reconcile divergent local and origin/main histories before publishing the checkpoint
completion_criteria: Reconciliation does not use force-push, reset, rebase, stash, or clean
A normal main-branch push is possible after an explicit history-resolution decision

tasks.title: Run Paper 1B's final independent confirmation spot-check
completion_criteria: The check uses the canonical Paper 1B source/PDF and is recorded in SSOT
Any findings are truth-audited and reflected in the paper/site state before readiness changes
No readiness claim exceeds the available evidence

watchpoints: Keep raw prompts raw; put audit conclusions in task and plan files.
Read SSOT before paper work and never commit local environment backups.
At handoff fetch, origin/main was 1,574 commits ahead while local main was 2 commits ahead; do not auto-reconcile divergent history.
